prompt_text:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the beer can in <Picture 1>: a 500 ml aluminum beer can with a blue top and lid, a silver-white metallic body, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD" near the top, large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" across the middle and a red label block reading "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER".

summary:
[reference generation] A close insert of <Subject 1> standing on a stone ledge by the river at night while a young man's hand frames it with a black smartphone camera and taps once.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the can's proportions, blue top, silver-white body, blue "SUPER DRY" lettering, small "BRAVE THE WORLD" text and red "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER" block are retained exactly.

detailed_description:
The target video is a photorealistic premium television commercial filmed with a 35 mm lens and shallow depth of field, with deep blue night tones and warm golden bokeh.
[Shot 1] A close insert shot at the height of a smooth, light-gray stone ledge beside the river at night. <Subject 1> stands upright on the ledge slightly right of center, its label facing the camera: the blue top, the silver-white metallic body, small blue letters "BRAVE THE WORLD", large bold blue letters "SUPER DRY" and the red block "SUPER DRY DRAFT BEER", with fine condensation droplets catching the light. A soft warm highlight from the city lights runs along its left edge. Behind the can, warm city lights across the dark water glow as soft, round golden bokeh circles against deep blue darkness. A young man's right hand, with the cuff of a dark blue-gray overshirt at the wrist, enters from the left of the frame holding a black smartphone sideways at the left of the can, its camera lens pointed at the can and its screen turned toward him, away from the camera. He holds the phone steady about an arm's length from the can to frame it, then makes one small tap on the screen with his thumb; the phone's edge catches a faint reflection. The can stays completely still and unchanged, and its lettering stays sharp. The stone surface shows a fine natural grain and a few small damp patches. The camera holds a static shot for the whole duration. There is no other text anywhere in the frame.

overall_soundscape: Low riverside ambience and soft water movement continue under one subtle, quiet phone camera shutter sound.

non_diegetic_music: Ambient electronic music at a slow tempo: sustained synth pads with a soft low pulse and a low, sustained bass note, kept low in volume.
